newsitem.title: UK: British police probing Nazi festival arrest four.
newsitem.headline: British police probing Nazi festival arrest four.

text.p: British police hunting the venue for a neo-Nazi rock festival on Thursday arrested four people at a house in Wales.
"Two of them are men from America, one is a local man, another is a local woman. The house is still being searched," a police spokeswoman said after the four were seized in Cardiff.
Police are probing plans to hold a weekend rock concert that they fear may attract up to 1,000 extreme right-wingers from across North America and Europe.
Leaflets have advised would-be fans of the so-called "Aryan fest" to congregate first at two motorway service stations on Saturday afternoon.
Among bands due to play at the festival are Intimidation One from the United States and the English groups White Law and Brutal Attack.
Politicians have called on interior minister Jack Straw to call off the festival on public order grounds. The Anti-Nazi League has pledged to stage a mass demonstration if it goes ahead.
